extracted.name: Simple Sassy Salmon
extracted.description: Salmon is marinated in a sweet and tangy mixture of Worcestershire sauce and brown sugar that also doubles as a tasty glaze under the broiler.
instruction_lines: Whisk honey mustard, melted butter, oil, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, and garlic powder together in a bowl until well combined. Reserve 2 tablespoons marinade for basting.
Place salmon into a shallow baking dish and pour remaining marinade over top. Cover and refrigerate for 45 minutes.
Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 5 inches from the heat source.
Broil salmon in the preheated oven, brushing occasionally with the reserved 2 tablespoon marinade, until fish flakes easily with a fork and marinade has cooked into a glaze, about 12 minutes.
